title: Synthetic kickoff: habit tracker mobile app

messages.content: We are building a habit tracker for iOS and Android. First release is free, no purchases.
Understood. For storage, PostgreSQL is one option if you want a hosted backend.
No backend for v1. Decision: keep everything on device in SQLite.
Noted: on-device SQLite, no purchases in v1. Do you need offline reminders?
Yes, reminders must work offline. Accessibility: support Dynamic Type and TalkBack.
